title: Cow dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="30" ry="5" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  
  <!-- legs - dancing pose -->
  <!-- back left leg kicked up -->
  <rect x="28" y="68" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f5e6d0" transform="rotate(-25 32 77)"/>
  <rect x="24" y="82" width="9" height="6" rx="3" fill="#aa6633" transform="rotate(-25 32 77)"/>
  
  <!-- back right leg planted -->
  <rect x="40" y="68" width="8" height="22" rx="4" fill="#f5e6d0"/>
  <rect x="39" y="86" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="#aa6633"/>
  
  <!-- front left leg kicked forward -->
  <rect x="55" y="66" width="8" height="20" rx="4" fill="#f5e6d0" transform="rotate(20 59 76)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="82" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="#aa6633" transform="rotate(20 59 76)"/>
  
  <!-- front right leg up -->
  <rect x="65" y="64" width="8" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f5e6d0" transform="rotate(-15 69 73)"/>
  <rect x="62" y="78" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="#aa6633" transform="rotate(-15 69 73)"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="28" ry="18" fill="#f5e6d0"/>
  
  <!-- cow spots on body -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="54" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="50" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="73" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ff99bb"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="77" r="2" fill="#ffbbcc"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="78" r="2" fill="#ffbbcc"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="77" r="2" fill="#ffbbcc"/>
  
  <!-- tail swishing -->
  <path d="M22 55 Q10 50 8 40" stroke="#f5e6d0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="38" r="4" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="18" ry="15" fill="#f5e6d0"/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="28" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f5e6d0" transform="rotate(-20 30 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="28" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#ff99bb" transform="rotate(-20 30 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="28" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#f5e6d0" transform="rotate(20 70 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="28" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#ff99bb" transform="rotate(20 70 28)"/>
  
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d="M38 20 Q34 12 38 9" stroke="#ffdd88" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 20 Q66 12 62 9" stroke="#ffdd88" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- spot on head -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="26" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#ffbbcc"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="39" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="39" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d="M44 44 Q50 49 56 44" stroke="#3a2a50" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="30" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="30" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#3a2a50"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill="#ffdd44">
    <circle cx="82" cy="20" r="3"/>
    <rect x="84" y="8" width="2" height="12" fill="#ffdd44"/>
    <path d="M86 8 Q92 6 92 12" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    
    <circle cx="14" cy="14" r="2.5"/>
    <rect x="15.5" y="4" width="1.5" height="10" fill="#ffdd44"/>
    <path d="M17 4 Q22 2 22 8" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#88ddff">
    <circle cx="78" cy="45" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="40" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="85" cy="60" r="1.5"/>
  </g>
</svg>
